text:
anya: Quick sync 1: marketplace dry-run this Friday. Goal: complete staging publish and verify billing + onboarding UX. Can we lock owners?

devin: I'll run AMI publish + billing metadata export. Will need sku slug and billing dimension mapping from product.

marcos: GCP publisher flows side, I'll validate OAuth redirect URIs and the service account role list. Heads-up: vendor portal UI changed last week.

laura: Azure private offer + test tenant. I'll prep the ARM template and a small runbook for test redeploy/rollback.

sarah-legal: I updated the offer text with the KMS & data-retention paragraph and added a short privacy note for EU customers. Posted link in drive.

emily-marketing: I'll assemble the 128x128 and 1024x512 assets and provide localized copy for EN/FR/DE. Expect drafts by Thursday.

anya: Thanks. Devin, include a sample usage CSV schema for the billing export so finance can validate.

devin: Will do. Sample export looks like:
```csv
date,customer_id,sku,units,tokens,amount_usd
2024-06-01,cust_123,redwood-pro,100,25000,120.50
```

marcos: Publisher portal blocked me on one permission yesterday; it required roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter for the service account. Adding that to the list.

laura: Noted. Also Azure wants a short paragraph for the private offer terms (how trial maps to entitlement). Sarah, can you confirm wording?

sarah-legal: Confirmed. I added this sentence: "Trial entitlements provide limited access to hosted inference; customers must accept the EULA and KMS terms to enable private deployment features."

anya: Good. Two operational asks: (1) cloud-bot create staging entitlement and temp pub account (2) set up a smoke test matrix and owners.

cloud-bot: created staging entitlement: rw-marketplace-staging-1745; staging publisher account created: pub-staging-1745. Credentials pushed to #vault. :white_check_mark:

devin: Smoke test matrix (high level): AMI boot, register with publisher, entitlement activation, first API call, billing export, embed/sample app token flow. I'll create a test checklist.

emily-marketing: We'll also validate the listing copy renders correctly in the partner storefront and that localized strings fit the hero area.

marcos: Plan to run the publisher flow twice (fresh account + existing account) to catch onboarding regressions. I'll post any portal errors here.

laura: I'll prepare a rollback playbook with commands and the ARM template snippet. Will include run commands and tag-based cleanup.

anya: Timeline: Thursday drafts (legal, creative, ARM, billing examples). Friday dry-run at 10am PT. Post-mortem Friday 3pm.

sarah-legal: I'll watch the dry-run and be on-call for wording or contract questions.

devin: One more thing: for metering granularity we need to agree per-1k token vs per-request. Ops prefers per-1k. Product?

anya: Product leans per-1k tokens. Use per-1k in billing export and pricing copy.

marcos: If publisher portal rejects our roles again I'll escalate to partner ops; will attach screenshots.

cloud-bot: reminder created: marketplace-dryrun Friday 10:00 PT -> attendees: @anya @devin @marcos @laura @emily-marketing @sarah-legal

emily-marketing: I'll also draft the short announcement blurb for partner comms in case publish succeeds.

anya: Thanks team. I updated the onboarding tracker with owners and linked the assets folder. Ping me if you need more time.

devin: Filing a quick checklist PR now with the CSV sample and AMI naming convention: redwood-inference-ami-<region>-v1

anya: End thread.
